correctness.rationale: Every face of the independence complex is contained in a common-label star or an exceptional triangle. The star-cover nerve has the integral chain complex of K_m, with H_1=exterior-square augmentation lattice. The only relative cells are the exceptional 2-simplices, whose connecting boundary is integral augmentation contraction from exterior cube of the permutation lattice onto that cycle lattice; its kernel is exterior cube of the augmentation lattice. The relative long exact sequence proves all degrees, torsion-freeness and equivariance for every m>=5. The group-quotient claims follow by rational transfer and exact invariant functors; cyclic orbit counts respect orientation signs. A standalone exact checker independently verifies finite homology and every signed group-element trace in S_5,S_6,S_7 and all eight rotations in size eight.
